scope: Compile original LeePositionController implementation unchanged against ROS-independent compatibility types; Bullet adapter is new

adaptations.controller: lee_position_controller.cpp is compiled directly from unmodified vendor source; ROS1 message includes replaced by field-compatible C++ types in include/
adaptations.vehicle: Controller mass/inertia/rotor layout and gains from original RMF YAML; motor lag/limits and body dimensions from RMF xacro
adaptations.physics: New Bullet 3.06 adapter: one rigid body, original rotor force/torque allocation, first-order motor response, lateral drag and rolling moment
adaptations.sensor: New Bullet closest-ray lidar, 6480 total rays, 7 m range. Default legacy frame coincides with body; optional dual layout uses front/rear offsets +/-0.2 m, rear yaw pi, 3240 rays each, acquisition-time TF and 25 ms transport delay.
adaptations.initialization: Starts at hover with equilibrium rotor speed at (-2,0,0); no takeoff or landing phase
adaptations.trajectory: Hold timed trajectory samples with supplied derivatives, matching the original controller input; no pose reassignment during motion
adaptations.mission_speed: Physical demo defaults 0.25 m/s; original kinematic demo was 1.0 m/s; not a matched performance comparison
adaptations.world: Synthetic two-room collision world, not the original DARPA cave/Gazebo world

native_gazebo_consumer.scope: Exports unchanged Lee core to a ROS2 controller which commands native rotor plugins; existing Bullet adapter unchanged
